feature.title: Up to 300 parts in 3 cm
feature.text: A mechanical calibre is a tiny machine of springs, gears and jewels. Our watchmakers open, clean, oil and time each one.

facts.label: Jewels
facts.text: Synthetic rubies reduce friction at every pivot

facts.label: Balance wheel
facts.text: Beats 28,800 times an hour for steady timekeeping

typesSection.title: Four ways to keep time
typesSection.subtitle: Every watch in our store uses one of these. Look for the label on each product card.

movementTypes.title: Quartz
movementTypes.text: A battery makes a quartz crystal vibrate 32,768 times a second. Accurate to ±15 seconds a month.

movementTypes.title: Automatic
movementTypes.text: A weighted rotor winds the mainspring as your wrist moves. No battery needed.

movementTypes.title: Eco-Drive
movementTypes.text: Citizen's light-powered movement charges from any light and runs 6+ months in the dark.

movementTypes.title: Smart
movementTypes.text: Heart rate, GPS, notifications and contactless payment, synced with your phone.

materials.title: 18k gold
materials.text: Warm, heavy and hypoallergenic — polished by hand.

materials.title: 904L steel
materials.text: Highly corrosion-resistant steel used on dive watches.

materials.title: Leather & sapphire
materials.text: Calfskin straps and scratch-proof sapphire crystal.
